paragraphs: If your CLK 220 is a 2002–2009 model with the M271 engine — that's the C209 generation — timing chain stretch and balance shaft issues are a well-documented pattern on this engine, confirmed by established Mercedes specialist consensus. We replace the timing chain, timing gears and gaskets as standard on every M271 rebuild.
The earlier C208 generation (1997–2003) uses the M111 engine, which doesn't share this specific issue — it's a different, older design without the same documented timing chain pattern.
warning.source: Source: established Mercedes specialist pattern per VRF-mercedes-clk.md. M111 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to generation
